description: A finished branch that changes the RSVP digest's subject for an issue whose needs:decision proposal the owner has not answered, with no network and no one to ask. Tests whether prep-pr sees that the pull request waits on the owner and would open it as a draft with -F draft=true, ends the body's Impact with a merge-hold line naming the public issue, records the choice as a decision open for the owner with its options and a recommendation, keeps the six-section shape, and claims no pull request opened and no gate passed.
